requirements:
# Aeration Blower Delayed Start

- **Difficulty:** Easy (easy)

## Requirements

Control a wastewater-treatment aeration blower with a low-dissolved-oxygen demand, a 5-second start delay, emergency-stop priority and start-cycle counting.

1. Start delay timing when both DO_LOW and AERATION_E_STOP_NC are TRUE. Allow BLOWER_RUN to become TRUE only after these conditions have remained satisfied for 5 seconds.
2. If DO_LOW becomes FALSE or an emergency stop occurs, immediately disable BLOWER_RUN and reset the start timer, whether timing is incomplete or complete. A new demand must wait the full 5 seconds again.
3. Increment AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT once on each FALSE-to-TRUE transition of BLOWER_RUN. Do not count repeatedly during continuous operation.
4. At power-up, initialize the blower to OFF and the start count to zero. The start delay gates a BOOL enable; no continuous speed ramp is required.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `DO_LOW` | `BOOL` | Dissolved oxygen is below its threshold and aeration is needed. |
| Input | `AERATION_E_STOP_NC` | `BOOL` | TRUE means the emergency stop is inactive; FALSE means it is active. |
| Output | `BLOWER_RUN` | `BOOL` | Blower motor-contactor run command. |
| Output | `AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT` | `UINT` | Count of actual blower starts. |

scan_semantics: At scan k, inputs I[k] are sampled once, q[k] is pre-scan retained state, outputs O[k] are observed after execution, and q[k+1] is the updated state. Each test creates a fresh FB instance before step 0. An initialized instance has not yet executed a scan. Timer elapsed time is zero on the first eligible sampled invocation; dt_ms is elapsed wall time since the previous invocation, not automatically a synthetic input to the FB. No unobserved past input stability is assumed. All sequences here are expected values.
safety_priority: DO_LOW FALSE or emergency stop overrides timing and resets it immediately.
assumptions: Start delay elapsed is zero at the first sample of DO_LOW & AERATION_E_STOP_NC; run becomes TRUE at elapsed>=5s.
Count increments on the same invocation that changes end-of-scan BLOWER_RUN from FALSE to TRUE.
Tests stay below UINT overflow; overflow behavior is outside the specified operating domain.
The specification_contract is normative and supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.

ltl.explanation: Run is enabled only after the full delay.
Loss of demand or safety permissive clears run and its timer.
No repeated count during continuous operation or stop.
A sustained permitted demand eventually starts under advancing time.
The complete per-invocation relation defined in specification_contract.normative_completion; requires explicit encoding before model checking.

atomic_propositions.delayDone: Permissive has continuously remained true for >=5s after its first sampled TRUE.
atomic_propositions.interface names: Identically named sampled input or observed output.

tests.purpose: Exact delay threshold, sustained operation and second counted start
Emergency stop discards partial and completed delay
Permission loss at the exact deadline wins; recovery starts a fresh full interval, even after a long gap.

specification_contract.observation: I[k] is sampled before execution; O[k] is observed after execution. Initial conditions apply before invocation zero.
specification_contract.normative_completion: 将permit连续计时、首次TRUE年龄0、FALSE清零定义成确定时钟状态；运行与permit且elapsed>=5s等价。初始runPrev=FALSE、countPrev=0，每拍更新。加入累计启动次数<65536的评测域或另外约定溢出策略。
specification_contract.history_binding: Every previous-output name refers to the preceding observed output with the declared initial value. Previous-input memories update on EVERY invocation, including reset, invalid input, stop and mode change. Reference phase/history is independently advanced from sampled inputs by the stated transition rules, never supplied by the candidate.
specification_contract.evaluation_scope: Properties include interpreted data predicates. No claim of export to a model checker or completed formal proof.
specification_contract.timing_binding: dt_ms is measured between invocations; the first invocation establishes time zero. An eligible period begins at its first eligible observation, with age zero. No time before that observation is credited. Missing/nonfinite/negative timing is rejected. Timed monitor acceptance is not evidence of a real PLC clock.
